preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 500.
Number of friends N is between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(L[i] <= R[i] for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: For each friend, the start time L[i] is less than or equal to the end time R[i].

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == N for line in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each output line has a length equal to the number of friends N.

postconditions.expression: all(char in '01' for line in return_value for char in line)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output lines is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: all((L[i] <= P <= R[i]) == (line[i] == '1') for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: For each friend, the i-th character in the output line is '1' if the meeting time P is between L[i] and R[i], inclusive; otherwise, it is '0'.
